## Summary

Describe the focused change and its user-visible result.

## Verification

- [ ] Frontend tests pass when applicable.
- [ ] Rust tests pass when applicable.
- [ ] Production or Tauri build passes when applicable.
- [ ] New behavior has deterministic regression coverage.

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, real Agent conversations, or unredacted screenshots are included.
- [ ] Native Agent sources remain read-only.
- [ ] User prompts, reasoning, tool parameters, and tool output are not exposed.
- [ ] New dependencies comply with the license policy.

## Developer Certificate of Origin

- [ ] Every commit contains a matching `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`).
